title: Callout Tools
text: Overview section plain Markdown content. Item Item B Figure: Scatter  Example Plots Figure: Boxplot  Example Plots Data Preview Notes Final notes bold text inline code.
code:
fig_scatter <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg, color = factor(cyl))) +   geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.85) +   labs(title = "Fuel Economy vs Weight", x = "Weight", y = "MPG", color = "Cyl") +   theme_minimal(base_size = 12)  fig_box <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(factor(cyl), mpg, fill = factor(cyl))) +   geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.85, width = 0.65, show.legend = FALSE) +   labs(title = "MPG Distribution by Cylinders", x = "Cylinders", y = "MPG") +   theme_minimal(base_size = 12)  content_items <- list(   "This section is plain Markdown content.

- Item A
- Item B",   fig_scatter,   fig_box,   head(mtcars, 5),   "Final notes with **bold text** and `inline code`." )  render_callout_content(   content_list = content_items,   titles = c("Overview", "Figure: Scatter", "Figure: Boxplot", "Data Preview", "Notes"),   callout_type = "note",   collapse = TRUE )

what: Merge multiple Quarto QMD files and optionally render — merge_render
title: Merge multiple Quarto QMD files and optionally render — merge_render
text: function reads multiple .qmd files, removes top-level YAML headers, merges bodies single temporary .qmd, optionally renders file quarto::quarto_render().

title: Merge multiple Quarto QMD files and optionally render — merge_render
code: merge_render(   input_files,   output_path,   render_dir = ".",   title = NULL,   output_format = "html",   overwrite = FALSE,   ... )

title: Merge multiple Quarto QMD files and optionally render — merge_render
text: input_files Character vector input .qmd file paths. output_path Final output path. example "knowledge.md", "report.html", "paper.docx", "merged.qmd". render_dir Directory merged source QMD created rendered. Defaults ".". title Optional title inserted merged QMD YAML header. output_format Optional Quarto output format. NULL, format inferred output_path. supplied, must consistent extension output_path. overwrite Logical. TRUE, overwrite output_path exists. ... Additional arguments passed quarto::quarto_render().

title: Merge multiple Quarto QMD files and optionally render — merge_render
Merge multiple Quarto QMD files and optionally render — merge_render
text: important design distinction : render_dir: merged QMD created Quarto run. output_path: final file path returned user. default, render_dir = ".", normal Quarto project behaviour used. render_dir inside directory tree containing _quarto.yml, Quarto may inherit project configuration. avoid inheriting _quarto.yml, use: render_dir = temp_render_dir()

what: Render any content in collapsible callouts — render_callout_content
title: Render any content in collapsible callouts — render_callout_content
text: Wraps list content blocks (text, plots, tables, htmlwidgets, Markdown) Quarto callouts optional collapse.

title: Render any content in collapsible callouts — render_callout_content
code: render_callout_content(   content_list,   titles = names(content_list),   callout_type = "note",   collapse = TRUE )

title: Render any content in collapsible callouts — render_callout_content
text: content_list List R objects. Can ggplot, HTML widget, character text, Markdown. titles Character vector unique titles. Defaults list names Section 1,2,... callout_type Callout type: "note", "tip", "warning", etc. collapse Logical. callouts start collapsed? Default TRUE.

title: Render any content in collapsible callouts — render_callout_content
